title: Isaiah Chapter 46 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Isaiah chapter 46 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Isaiah Chapter 46 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Isaiah Chapter 46.

questions.question: Which idols are mentioned as bowing down and stooping in Isaiah 46?
questions.correctAnswer: Bel and Nebo
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:1 specifically mentions Bel bowing down and Nebo stooping, making them the correct idols referenced.

questions.question: What is said about the idols' burden in Isaiah 46:1?
questions.correctAnswer: Their carriages were heavy loaden
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:1 states that their carriages were heavy loaden, indicating the idols were a burden.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 46:2, what happened to the idols themselves?
questions.correctAnswer: They went into captivity
questions.explanation: Verse 2 explains that the idols could not deliver the burden and themselves went into captivity.

questions.question: Who does Isaiah 46:3 call to hearken unto him?
options: House of Jacob and all the remnant of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: House of Jacob and all the remnant of Israel
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:3 calls the house of Jacob and all the remnant of Israel to listen to him.

questions.question: What analogy is used in Isaiah 46:3 to describe God's care for Israel?
options: Borne from the belly and carried from the womb
Like a father teaching his son
Like a king ruling his kingdom
questions.correctAnswer: Borne from the belly and carried from the womb
questions.explanation: Verse 3 uses the analogy of being borne from the belly and carried from the womb to describe God's care.

questions.question: What promise does God make in Isaiah 46:4 about carrying His people?
options: He will carry them even to old age and hoar hairs
He will abandon them in old age
He will send angels to carry them
questions.correctAnswer: He will carry them even to old age and hoar hairs
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:4 promises that God will carry His people even to their old age and hoar hairs.

questions.question: In Isaiah 46:5, what question does God ask about Himself?
options: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal?
Who can defeat me in battle?
questions.correctAnswer: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 asks the rhetorical question about to whom God can be likened or made equal.

questions.question: True or False: Isaiah 46:6 describes how the idols are made by hiring a goldsmith.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:6 states that they hire a goldsmith who makes the idol god.

questions.question: True or False: According to Isaiah 46:7, the idol can answer and save those who cry to it.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:7 clearly states the idol cannot answer nor save anyone out of trouble.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 46:8 command the transgressors to do?
questions.correctAnswer: Remember and show yourselves men
questions.explanation: Verse 8 instructs the transgressors to remember and show themselves men.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 46:9, how many gods are like God?
questions.correctAnswer: None
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:9 states that there is no god like Him, meaning none are like God.

questions.question: Which comes first in Isaiah 46:10?
options: Declaring the end from the beginning
Calling a ravenous bird from the east
He will carry you in old age
questions.correctAnswer: Declaring the end from the beginning
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:10 first declares the end from the beginning before other events later in the chapter.

questions.question: True or False: Isaiah 46:11 says God has purposed and will do His counsel.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Verse 11 confirms God has purposed His counsel and will bring it to pass.

questions.question: Who does Isaiah 46:12 address as 'stouthearted' and far from righteousness?
questions.correctAnswer: Those who refuse to listen
questions.explanation: Verse 12 calls out the stouthearted who are far from righteousness, referring to those refusing to listen.

questions.question: True or False: Isaiah 46:13 promises salvation will be placed in Zion for Israel as God's glory.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Verse 13 states that salvation will be placed in Zion for Israel, which is God's glory.

medium.title: Isaiah Chapter 46 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Isaiah Chapter 46 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 46:6, what process do people use to create their idols?
options: They lavish gold, weigh silver, and hire a goldsmith who makes the idol
They carve idols from wood using skilled craftsmen
They paint images on walls and worship them
They pray and fast to receive idols from heaven
questions.correctAnswer: They lavish gold, weigh silver, and hire a goldsmith who makes the idol
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:6 describes how people lavish gold out of the bag, weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith who makes the idol, which they then worship. This shows the human effort involved in idol-making.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 46:7 say about the idol's ability to help those who worship it?
options: The idol cannot answer or save from trouble
The idol grants blessings and answers prayers
The idol moves from place to place to protect worshippers
The idol speaks to the people and gives guidance
questions.correctAnswer: The idol cannot answer or save from trouble
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:7 states that the idol stands in its place and cannot move or save anyone who cries out to it, highlighting the futility of idol worship compared to trusting God.

questions.question: What command is given to transgressors in Isaiah 46:8?
options: Remember this and show yourselves men
Repent and turn back to God immediately
Offer sacrifices to the true God
questions.correctAnswer: Remember this and show yourselves men
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:8 urges transgressors to remember the truth about idols and God, and to act with understanding and maturity, showing themselves as men by recognizing God’s sovereignty.

questions.question: What unique characteristic of God is emphasized in Isaiah 46:9?
options: There is none else like Him
He created the heavens in six days
questions.correctAnswer: There is none else like Him
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:9 emphasizes God's uniqueness, declaring that He is God, and there is none else like Him, which contrasts with the powerless idols made by humans.

questions.question: How does Isaiah 46:10 describe God's knowledge and purpose?
options: He declares the end from the beginning and His counsel shall stand
He only knows the past and creates idols
He changes His mind often based on human actions
He hides His plans from mankind
questions.correctAnswer: He declares the end from the beginning and His counsel shall stand
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:10 teaches that God declares the end from the beginning and that His counsel will stand, showing His sovereignty and unchanging purpose over time.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 46:11, how does God accomplish His counsel?
options: By calling a ravenous bird from the east and a man from a far country
By giving visions to prophets in Israel only
questions.correctAnswer: By calling a ravenous bird from the east and a man from a far country
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:11 describes God calling a ravenous bird and a man from afar to execute His counsel, illustrating how God uses powerful agents to fulfill His plans.

questions.question: What kind of people is God addressing in Isaiah 46:12?
options: The stouthearted who are far from righteousness
The humble and meek of the earth
The priests and Levites in the temple
questions.correctAnswer: The stouthearted who are far from righteousness
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:12 addresses those who are proud and far from righteousness, calling them to listen to God's message.

questions.question: What promise does God make in Isaiah 46:13 about salvation?
options: He will place salvation in Zion for Israel His glory
He will send a prophet to condemn Israel
He will abandon Zion to the enemies
He will only save the foreigners
questions.correctAnswer: He will place salvation in Zion for Israel His glory
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:13 promises that God will bring near His righteousness and salvation, placing salvation in Zion for Israel, which is His glory.

questions.question: True or False: Isaiah 46:9 declares that God is unlike any other and there is no one else like Him.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:9 explicitly states, 'I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me,' affirming God's uniqueness.

questions.question: True or False: According to Isaiah 46:7, the idols can move from their place to help those who worship them.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:7 says the idol stands in its place and shall not move, and cannot answer or save those who cry unto it, showing its powerlessness.

questions.question: True or False: Isaiah 46:8 encourages transgressors to remember and reflect on God's truth.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:8 commands transgressors to remember God’s truth and show themselves as men by bringing it to mind, encouraging reflection and repentance.

questions.question: How does Isaiah 46:8-9 together encourage believers in their faith?
options: By commanding them to remember God’s uniqueness and act with understanding
By instructing them to build more idols for protection
By telling them to rely on foreign nations for help
By promising wealth if they worship gold and silver
questions.correctAnswer: By commanding them to remember God’s uniqueness and act with understanding
questions.explanation: Verses 8 and 9 together urge believers to remember God’s incomparable nature and to act wisely, rejecting idolatry and trusting in God alone.

questions.question: What practical lesson about prayer and trust can be learned from Isaiah 46:7?
options: Do not trust idols because they cannot answer or save
Pray to idols as they have power to help
Trust only in human leaders for deliverance
Idols are more powerful than God
questions.correctAnswer: Do not trust idols because they cannot answer or save
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:7 shows idols cannot move or help, teaching believers to place trust and prayer in God alone, not in powerless idols.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 46:10 teach about God's sovereignty over time?
options: God declares the end from the beginning, showing His control over all events
God changes His plans according to human desires
questions.correctAnswer: God declares the end from the beginning, showing His control over all events
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:10 explains that God declares the end from the beginning and His counsel will stand, highlighting His sovereign control over history.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 46:11 suggest about how God's plans are fulfilled?
options: God uses agents from afar to execute His counsel
God does not involve humans in His plans
God's plans can be changed by human rulers
questions.correctAnswer: God uses agents from afar to execute His counsel
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:11 describes God calling a ravenous bird and a man from a far country to carry out His purpose, signifying God’s use of distant powers to fulfill His will.

hard.title: Isaiah Chapter 46 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Isaiah Chapter 46.

questions.question: What does God declare He can do from ancient times, as stated in Isaiah 46?
options: Declare the end from the beginning
Create the heavens and the earth
questions.correctAnswer: Declare the end from the beginning
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:10 states God is declaring the end from the beginning, revealing His sovereign knowledge of all events from ancient times.

questions.question: Who is described as 'a ravenous bird from the east' in Isaiah 46?
options: The man that executeth God's counsel
questions.correctAnswer: The man that executeth God's counsel
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:11 identifies the 'ravenous bird from the east' as the man who executes God's counsel, showing God's control over distant nations and their actions.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 46, what is the condition of the idols Bel and Nebo?
options: They stoop down and cannot deliver their burden
They stand firm and protect their people
They speak and answer their worshippers
They shine brightly in the temple
questions.correctAnswer: They stoop down and cannot deliver their burden
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:1-2 describes Bel and Nebo bowing down and stooping, unable to deliver their burden, symbolizing the futility of idols.

questions.question: What does God say He will do even to old age and hoary hairs, according to Isaiah 46?
questions.correctAnswer: Carry and deliver His people
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:4 promises God will carry and deliver His people even into their old age and hoary hairs, highlighting His enduring care.

questions.question: What are the people in Isaiah 46 urged to do when told to 'Remember this, and shew yourselves men'?
questions.correctAnswer: Bring to mind their transgressions
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:8 calls transgressors to remember past things and show themselves men by repenting and reflecting on their sins.

questions.question: In Isaiah 46, what is the Hebrew word for 'righteousness' and what does it imply about God's character?
options: Tsedeq, implying justice and moral rightness
questions.correctAnswer: Tsedeq, implying justice and moral rightness
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word for righteousness in Isaiah 46:13 is 'tsedeq,' which denotes God's justice and moral uprightness, affirming His perfect character.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage echoes the theme of God declaring the end from the beginning as in Isaiah 46:10?
questions.correctAnswer: Revelation 1:8
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:8, where God is called 'the Alpha and Omega,' echoes Isaiah 46:10’s theme of God's eternal sovereignty and foreknowledge.

questions.question: What literary device is prominently used in Isaiah 46 to contrast the impotence of idols with the power of God?
questions.correctAnswer: Parallelism
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46 uses parallelism, especially in verses 1-2 and 6-7, contrasting the worthless idols that bow down with God's unmovable power.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 46, what will God place in Zion for Israel?
questions.correctAnswer: Salvation
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:13 states God will place salvation in Zion for Israel, indicating His plan for their deliverance and glorification.

questions.question: What burden do the idols Bel and Nebo carry according to Isaiah 46:1?
options: Heavy loads on beasts and cattle
The weight of gold and silver
questions.correctAnswer: Heavy loads on beasts and cattle
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:1 describes these idols as being upon beasts and cattle with heavy-laden carriages, symbolizing their burden and ineffectiveness.

questions.question: True or False: Isaiah 46:7 indicates that the idol can answer and save the person who cries to it.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:7 explicitly says the idol cannot answer nor save the one who cries to it, highlighting the futility of idol worship.

questions.question: Who is the original audience addressed in Isaiah 46:3 and following verses?
options: The house of Jacob and all the remnant of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The house of Jacob and all the remnant of Israel
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:3 addresses the house of Jacob and the remnant of Israel, emphasizing God's care for His chosen people.

questions.question: How does Isaiah 46:6 describe the process of idol-making?
options: Gold is lavished, silver is weighed, and a goldsmith makes it a god
Wood is carved and painted with bright colors
Stone is hewn and placed on an altar
Clay is molded and baked in a furnace
questions.correctAnswer: Gold is lavished, silver is weighed, and a goldsmith makes it a god
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:6 details the expensive process of making idols, which contrasts with their inability to help or save.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage reflects the theme of God carrying His people as in Isaiah 46:4?
questions.correctAnswer: Matthew 11:28-30
questions.explanation: Matthew 11:28-30 echoes God's promise in Isaiah 46:4 to carry and bear the weary, offering rest to the burdened.

questions.question: True or False: Isaiah 46:12 calls the stouthearted to remain far from righteousness.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:12 calls the stouthearted who are far from righteousness to hearken unto God, urging repentance, not continuation in sin.

theological.title: Isaiah Chapter 46 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Isaiah Chapter 46 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 46:1, what is the condition of the idols Bel and Nebo?
options: They bow down and stoop, burdening the beasts and cattle
They speak and prophesy to the people
They deliver the people from captivity
They ascend to heaven to intercede for Israel
questions.correctAnswer: They bow down and stoop, burdening the beasts and cattle
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:1 states that Bel boweth down and Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts and cattle, and their carriages were heavy laden, making them a burden to the weary beast. This indicates their inability to help or save.

questions.question: What happened to the idols according to Isaiah 46:2?
options: They went into captivity because they could not deliver their burden
questions.correctAnswer: They went into captivity because they could not deliver their burden
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:2 explains that the idols stoop and bow down together, but they could not deliver the burden; instead, they themselves went into captivity, demonstrating their powerlessness.

questions.question: What does God declare about His relationship to the house of Israel from birth according to Isaiah 46:3?
options: He has borne them from the belly and carried them from the womb
He has abandoned them to their own devices
He has chosen other nations over Israel
questions.correctAnswer: He has borne them from the belly and carried them from the womb
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:3 states that God calls the house of Jacob and the remnant of Israel to hear that He has borne them from the belly and carried them from the womb, signifying His sustaining care from the very beginning of their existence.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is revealed in Isaiah 46:4 when God says He will carry and deliver Israel even to their old age?
questions.correctAnswer: God's faithfulness and steadfast love
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:4 reveals God's enduring faithfulness and steadfast love as He promises to carry and deliver His people even to their old age and hoary hairs, demonstrating His unchanging commitment.

questions.question: In Isaiah 46:5, what challenge does God present to those who would liken Him to anything else?
options: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, that we may be alike?
Who can defeat me in battle?
Who can hide from my wrath?
Who can ascend to heaven like me?
questions.correctAnswer: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, that we may be alike?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:5 records God challenging idolaters to show whom they can compare Him with or make equal to Him, emphasizing His uniqueness and incomparable nature.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 46:6 teach about the human process of idol-making?
options: They lavish gold and silver, hire a goldsmith to make a god, and then worship it
They pray and fast to receive divine revelation
questions.correctAnswer: They lavish gold and silver, hire a goldsmith to make a god, and then worship it
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:6 describes the human effort in idol-making, highlighting the lavish spending on gold and silver and hiring craftsmen to fashion idols, which people then fall down and worship.

questions.question: According to Isaiah 46:7, what is the ultimate impotence of idols?
options: They cannot answer or save those who cry to them in trouble
They perform miracles and heal the sick
They provide true wisdom and counsel
questions.correctAnswer: They cannot answer or save those who cry to them in trouble
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:7 declares that idols stand fixed in their places and cannot move, and though one may cry to them, they cannot answer or save from trouble, illustrating their powerlessness.

questions.question: What exhortation does God give to transgressors in Isaiah 46:8?
options: Remember this and show yourselves men by bringing it again to mind
Continue in your ways without fear
Trust in the strength of idols
Ignore past lessons and seek new gods
questions.correctAnswer: Remember this and show yourselves men by bringing it again to mind
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:8 commands transgressors to remember the impotence of idols and to act wisely ('show yourselves men') by recalling these facts, urging repentance and understanding.

questions.question: Which attribute of God is strongly emphasized in Isaiah 46:9 where God declares 'I am God, and there is none else'?
questions.correctAnswer: God's uniqueness and exclusivity
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:9 emphasizes the attribute of God's uniqueness and exclusivity by declaring there is no other like Him, affirming monotheism and His incomparable nature.

questions.question: What does Isaiah 46:10 reveal about God's knowledge and sovereignty?
options: God declares the end from the beginning and ensures His counsel shall stand
God is uncertain about future events
God requires humans to decide their own fate
God is limited to present knowledge only
questions.correctAnswer: God declares the end from the beginning and ensures His counsel shall stand
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:10 reveals God's sovereign foreknowledge and control over history, declaring the end from the beginning and stating that His counsel will stand and His pleasure will be done.

questions.question: How does Isaiah 46:11 illustrate God's power to execute His purposes?
options: God calls a ravenous bird from the east to execute His counsel from afar
God depends on human armies to accomplish His will
God delegates His authority to idols
questions.correctAnswer: God calls a ravenous bird from the east to execute His counsel from afar
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:11 metaphorically describes God calling a ravenous bird (often interpreted as a conqueror or agent) from the east to carry out His sovereign counsel, demonstrating His power and purposeful action.

questions.question: Who are addressed in Isaiah 46:12 as 'stouthearted' and far from righteousness?
options: Those who resist God's call and persist in sin
questions.correctAnswer: Those who resist God's call and persist in sin
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:12 calls out the 'stouthearted' who are far from righteousness, referring to those who are stubborn, rebellious sinners rejecting God's ways.

questions.question: What future hope does God promise in Isaiah 46:13 for Israel?
options: He will bring near His righteousness and salvation, placing salvation in Zion as His glory
He will abandon Israel to exile forever
He will let Israel rely on idols
questions.correctAnswer: He will bring near His righteousness and salvation, placing salvation in Zion as His glory
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:13 promises that God will bring near His righteousness and salvation, which will not tarry, and He will place salvation in Zion for Israel, showing His redemptive plan and glory.

questions.question: What combined doctrinal truth emerges from Isaiah 46:3 and Isaiah 46:4 about God's sustaining work?
options: God sustains His people from birth through old age with a faithful, personal care
God only sustains the righteous after conversion
God sustains the idols more than His people
God's care is limited to earthly blessings
questions.correctAnswer: God sustains His people from birth through old age with a faithful, personal care
questions.explanation: Verses 3 and 4 together affirm that God bears His people from the womb and carries them even to old age and hoary hairs, emphasizing His lifelong, faithful sustaining care (Isaiah 46:3-4).

questions.question: What theological insight is gained by combining Isaiah 46:5-6 and Isaiah 46:7 regarding idols and God?
options: Idols are human-made and powerless to save, whereas God is incomparable and sovereign
Idols are equally powerful as God
Idols can move and answer prayers
questions.correctAnswer: Idols are human-made and powerless to save, whereas God is incomparable and sovereign
questions.explanation: Isaiah 46:5-6 describes idols as human-crafted objects worshiped in vain, while Isaiah 46:7 shows their inability to answer or save, highlighting God's incomparable sovereignty in contrast.
